latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release with real-time federal financial intelligence tools:

- Search SEC EDGAR for company filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, etc).
- Retrieve BLS employment statistics, including unemployment rate and payrolls.
- Access USDA crop and commodity prices by state and year.
- No API keys required; uses free government data sources.
- Easy setup for integration with mcporter or OpenClaw MCP.
